Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct MappingPage overview
  |   |   |-- Replace the obsolete injected DiagramService and controller content-writer description with retained revision operations and CanvasHistoryService calls; retain the existing [G] and [E] connections for reanchoring
  |   |   |-- Show MappingEditorCanvas as the page's editor host, with CanvasSession-owned document, presentation, selection and controller state; distinguish document alternatives and reviews from per-placement view state
  |   |   `-- Keep the FloatingBox registry distinct from attached SidePanel records and source-window rendering
  |   |-- [1b] Extend MappingPage overview
  |   |   |-- MappingPage owns PromptComposerCoordinator and calls PromptComposer and VariantReview; the coordinator owns drafts, pinned references, target scopes, run status and panel conversation context, while the controller applies acknowledged revisions
  |   |   |-- MappingPage calls CanvasViewControls and CanvasViewDiffPreview through the session controller; saved-view history remains controller-owned
  |   |   |-- MappingPage owns SourceWindowPanel: it reads retained projected source/code pane records from CanvasSession, renders the active pane outside the canvas, and updates logical pane state through the controller [M3]
  |   |   |-- MappingPage owns DiagramSearchService and calls DiagramSearchPanel; the service owns its worker index and results, while MappingPage checks revisions and owns match focus and proposal/live navigation
  |   |   |-- MappingPage calls CanvasTreemapContent or ChangeTreemapContent in workspace tools; they own source reads or change-preview reads and treemap display state, while MappingPage owns canvas tint and navigation focus
  |   |   |-- MappingPage calls projectDiagrams through runWorkspaceTask and owns child-draft introduction; ProjectionLayoutPanel calls the worker layout task and controller, with projection settings retained in child canvas state and transfer/history navigation coordinated by the workspace
  |   |   |-- Preserve useAgentCanvasBridge as the live command caller of the controller [D], including revision, generation, canvas-view and projection requests; retain WorkspacePersistence as the autosave caller, separate from explicit checkpoint publication
  |   |   `-- Attachment points: PromptComposerCoordinator [N4], DiagramSearchService [N6], MappingPage's treemap tools [N7], and MappingPage's projectDiagrams/ProjectionLayoutPanel component [N8]
  |   |-- [1a] Correct [C] FloatingBox variants [M3]
  |   |   `-- Retain ProjectedPane source-code and code-panel content as logical panel records, but transfer their rendering to overview SourceWindowPanel; SidePanel alternatives are not FloatingBox variants
  |   |-- [2] Add: Scoped authoring and alternative-presentation UI [N4]
  |   |   `-- Attach to overview PromptComposerCoordinator; cover pinned references, scoped edit/create/extend prompts, variant review, placement choices and the separate attached SidePanel controls
  |   |-- [2] Add: Worker diagram search and result reveal [N6]
  |   |   `-- Attach to overview DiagramSearchService; cover current-content indexing, canvas/project/proposal scope, cancellation, revision-checked focus and match reveal, plus mapped-source navigation through SourceWindowPanel
  |   |-- [2] Add: Canvas and change treemaps [N7]
  |   |   `-- Attach to overview MappingPage treemap tools; cover shared rendering and navigation, mapped-source coverage versus change-hunk allocation, and unresolved destinations without assuming a fully mapped DiffTree
  |   `-- [2] Add: Focused child-canvas projection [N8]
  |       `-- Attach to overview MappingPage projectDiagrams/ProjectionLayoutPanel; cover selected or highlighted diagram copies, child history and parent identity, worker layout settings, and child-only undo/redo
  |
  |-- Roll-up 1 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct MappingPage overview
  |   |   `-- Make the same editor, revision ownership, document/presentation and SidePanel boundary corrections as the original; retain and reanchor its existing connections
  |   |-- [1b] Extend MappingPage overview
  |   |   `-- Introduce the same explicit authoring, CanvasViews, SourceWindowPanel, search, treemap, projection, agent-command and persistence callers and their owned state; refer to the original canvas's N4/N6/N7/N8 details
  |   `-- [1a] Correct [C] FloatingBox variants [M3]
  |       `-- Retain logical projected pane records but locate source/code rendering in overview SourceWindowPanel, not [C]; keep SidePanel separate
